description.value:
You worship the ancestral deity of Czelle, the great ocean spirit Aspalasch, seen as the protector both of binnaquids and all other life on the planet. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Aspalasch Lore.

Additionally, Aspalasch grants you magical gifts. Choose one divine cantrip from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Forbidding Ward], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Guidance], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Message], and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Summon Instrument]. You can cast that cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
